blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: How to make some mighty good ramen

Follow directions above except add warm water to the fill line inside cup. Microwave on high to boil (about 1 minute 30 seconds), but stop before it boils over. Microwaves can have a mind of their own - you may need to add more time but stop microwave if product is overcooking. Stir, cover tightly, and let stand 6 minutes. If you prefer extra tender noodles, microwave uncovered again as needed. Stir in contents of both packets. Enjoy!
